meta.title: CSS variables
meta.description: Every design token of React Scheduler, with its light and dark default, generated from the package’s stylesheet.

intro: Every visual value of the component is a custom property on its root. They are the lightest way to change how it looks: set one anywhere the root inherits from, or pass it through the tokens prop, and everything built from it follows.
how: The tables below are generated from the package’s own tokens.css, so they cannot fall behind it. Each row is addressable — link to a token with #css-color-now, for instance.

color.title: Color
color.text: The surfaces, the text, the lines and the accents. These are the values a dark scheme replaces.

typography.title: Typography
typography.text: The two families, and a size, a line height and a weight for each kind of text the component draws.

levels.title: Levels
levels.text: One color and one on-color per level key of the classic scale, plus the angle the alert surface is drawn at. A scale of your own with its own keys reads its colors from its own definitions.

shape.title: Shape and depth
shape.text: Radii, shadows, the focus ring and the dialog border.

motion.title: Motion
motion.text: The durations and easings of the two things that move. Under reduced motion they are not used at all.

layout.title: Layout
layout.text: The measurements that are neither color nor type: the widths of the pinned chips, the padding of the grid, the height of a pill, the width of the rail.
